product.name: ExampleDispatch
product.description: schedule and dispatch technicians for small HVAC and plumbing companies

documents.text: I was so frustrated with spreadsheets. Scheduling my techs takes hours every week and someone always gets double-booked. I just want something simple so that I can stop doing it manually.
Switched from BigFSM because it kept crashing and support was terrible. Way too complicated for a 6-truck shop.
Love how easy it is to set up. Saves me hours every week on scheduling. The text reminders mean fewer no-shows.
Honestly it looks good but it's too expensive for a small shop like mine, not sure it's worth it. I'm also worried about moving all our customer data over.
We cancelled because the mobile app was slow in areas with bad signal.
The last straw was when we missed two emergency calls in one week because the board was wrong. That's when I started looking for software. I need to see the whole week at a glance.
Scheduling takes hours every week. I wish the techs could see their jobs on their phones.
The setup was confusing, I couldn't figure out how to import my customer list.

offer.name: ExampleDispatch Pro
offer.target_customer: owner-operators of HVAC and plumbing companies with 3-15 technicians
offer.problem: Scheduling technicians by phone and spreadsheet takes hours every week and causes double-bookings
offer.desired_outcome: Schedule a full week of jobs in under 30 minutes with no double-bookings
offer.value_proposition: See and schedule every technician's week on one screen, with automatic text reminders
offer.differentiation: Unlike spreadsheets, technicians see jobs on their phones and customers get reminders automatically

copy: Still scheduling techs on spreadsheets? ExampleDispatch lets you schedule a full week of jobs in under 30 minutes. Unlike spreadsheets, your techs see their jobs on their phones and customers get automatic text reminders. Start your free 14-day trial.
